sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash — Fast, Low-Cost Agent Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is the general release of MiniMax's M3.1 Flash model, announced on October 19, 2026. It follows MiniMax M3.1-Flash-Preview, which debuted in MiniMax Code on September 28, 2026 and was limited to the M Plan subscription.
